title: Service and Ministry
definition: Service and ministry by the Spirit means that believers serve God and others through the strength, gifts, and grace supplied by the Holy Spirit.
summary: Christian ministry is not self-promotion. It is Spirit-enabled service that points people to Christ and builds up the Church.
christFocus: The Spirit empowers believers to serve as witnesses and servants of Christ.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Christian ministry is not self-promotion. It is Spirit-enabled service that points people to Christ and builds up the Church.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, follow Christ faithfully, and avoid confusion in doctrine and daily life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
